paragraphs.text: translated by
1. WHAT Splendid One, Loud-voiced, Far striding, dost thou, well knowing, urge us to exalt with praises?
paragraphs.original: कं नश्चित्रमिषण्यसि चिकित्वान्पृथुग्मानं वाश्रं वावृधध्यै ।
paragraphs.translit: kaṃ naścitramiṣaṇyasi cikitvānpṛthugmānaṃ vāśraṃ vāvṛdhadhyai |

paragraphs.text: What give we him? When his might dawned, he fashioned the Vrtra-slaying bolt, and sent us waters.
paragraphs.original: कत्तस्य दातु शवसो व्युष्टौ तक्षद्वज्रं वृत्रतुरमपिन्वत्
paragraphs.translit: kattasya dātu śavaso vyuṣṭau takṣadvajraṃ vṛtraturamapinvat

paragraphs.text: 2. He goes to end his work with lightning flashes: wide is the seat his Asura glory gives him.
paragraphs.original: स हि द्युता विद्युता वेति साम पृथुं योनिमसुरत्वा ससाद ।
paragraphs.translit: sa hi dyutā vidyutā veti sāma pṛthuṃ yonimasuratvā sasāda |

paragraphs.text: With his Companions, not without his Brother, he quells Saptatha's magic devices.
paragraphs.original: स सनीळेभिः प्रसहानो अस्य भ्रातुर्न ऋते सप्तथस्य मायाः
paragraphs.translit: sa sanīḷebhiḥ prasahāno asya bhrāturna ṛte saptathasya māyāḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. On most auspicious path he goes to battle he toiled to win heaven's light, full fain to gain it;
paragraphs.original: स वाजं यातापदुष्पदा यन्स्वर्षाता परि षदत्सनिष्यन् ।
paragraphs.translit: sa vājaṃ yātāpaduṣpadā yansvarṣātā pari ṣadatsaniṣyan |

paragraphs.text: He seized the hundred-gated castle's treasure by craft, unchecked, and slew the lustful demons.
paragraphs.original: अनर्वा यच्छतदुरस्य वेदो घ्नञ्छिश्नदेवाँ अभि वर्पसा भूत्
paragraphs.translit: anarvā yacchatadurasya vedo ghnañchiśnadevām̐ abhi varpasā bhūt

paragraphs.text: 4. Fighting for kine, the prize of war, and I roaming among the berd be brings the young streams hither,
paragraphs.original: स यह्व्योऽवनीर्गोष्वर्वा जुहोति प्रधन्यासु सस्रिः ।
paragraphs.translit: sa yahvyo'vanīrgoṣvarvā juhoti pradhanyāsu sasriḥ |

paragraphs.text: Where, footless, joined, without a car to bear them, with jars for steeds, they pour their flood like butter.
paragraphs.original: अपादो यत्र युज्यासोऽरथा द्रोण्यश्वास ईरते घृतं वाः
paragraphs.translit: apādo yatra yujyāso'rathā droṇyaśvāsa īrate ghṛtaṃ vāḥ

paragraphs.text: 5. Bold, unsolicited for wealth, with Rudras he came, the Blameless, having left his dwelling,
paragraphs.original: स रुद्रेभिरशस्तवार ऋभ्वा हित्वी गयमारेअवद्य आगात् ।
paragraphs.translit: sa rudrebhiraśastavāra ṛbhvā hitvī gayamāreavadya āgāt |

paragraphs.text: Came, seized the food of Vamra and his consort, and left the couple weeping and unsheltered.
paragraphs.original: वम्रस्य मन्ये मिथुना विवव्री अन्नमभीत्यारोदयन्मुषायन्
paragraphs.translit: vamrasya manye mithunā vivavrī annamabhītyārodayanmuṣāyan

paragraphs.text: 6. Lord of the dwelling, he subdued the demon who roared aloud, six-eyed and triple-headed.
paragraphs.original: स इद्दासं तुवीरवं पतिर्दन्षळक्षं त्रिशीर्षाणं दमन्यत् ।
paragraphs.translit: sa iddāsaṃ tuvīravaṃ patirdanṣaḷakṣaṃ triśīrṣāṇaṃ damanyat |

paragraphs.text: Trta, made stronger by the might he lent him, struck down the boar with shaft whose point was iron.
paragraphs.original: अस्य त्रितो न्वोजसा वृधानो विपा वराहमयोअग्रया हन्
paragraphs.translit: asya trito nvojasā vṛdhāno vipā varāhamayoagrayā han

paragraphs.text: 7. He raised himself on high and shot his arrow against the guileful and oppressive foeman.
paragraphs.original: स द्रुह्वणे मनुष ऊर्ध्वसान आ साविषदर्शसानाय शरुम् ।
paragraphs.translit: sa druhvaṇe manuṣa ūrdhvasāna ā sāviṣadarśasānāya śarum |

paragraphs.text: Strong, glorious, manliest, for us he shattered the forts of Nabus when he slew the Dasyus.
paragraphs.original: स नृतमो नहुषोऽस्मत्सुजातः पुरोऽभिनदर्हन्दस्युहत्ये
paragraphs.translit: sa nṛtamo nahuṣo'smatsujātaḥ puro'bhinadarhandasyuhatye

paragraphs.text: 8. He, like a cloud that rains upon the pasture, hath found for us the way to dwell in safety.
paragraphs.original: सो अभ्रियो न यवस उदन्यन्क्षयाय गातुं विदन्नो अस्मे ।
paragraphs.translit: so abhriyo na yavasa udanyankṣayāya gātuṃ vidanno asme |

paragraphs.text: When the Hawk comes in body to the Soma, armed with his iron claws he slays the Dasyus.
paragraphs.original: उप यत्सीददिन्दुं शरीरैः श्येनोऽयोपाष्टिर्हन्ति दस्यून्
paragraphs.translit: upa yatsīdadinduṃ śarīraiḥ śyeno'yopāṣṭirhanti dasyūn

paragraphs.text: 9. He with his potent Friends gave up the mighty, gave Gusnia up to Kutsa for affliction.
paragraphs.original: स व्राधतः शवसानेभिरस्य कुत्साय शुष्णं कृपणे परादात् ।
paragraphs.translit: sa vrādhataḥ śavasānebhirasya kutsāya śuṣṇaṃ kṛpaṇe parādāt |

paragraphs.text: He led the lauded Kavi, he delivered Atka as prey to him and to his heroes.
paragraphs.original: अयं कविमनयच्छस्यमानमत्कं यो अस्य सनितोत नृणाम्
paragraphs.translit: ayaṃ kavimanayacchasyamānamatkaṃ yo asya sanitota nṛṇām

paragraphs.text: 10. He, with his Gods who love mankind, the Wondrous, giving like Varuna who works with magic,
paragraphs.original: अयं दशस्यन्नर्येभिरस्य दस्मो देवेभिर्वरुणो न मायी ।
paragraphs.translit: ayaṃ daśasyannaryebhirasya dasmo devebhirvaruṇo na māyī |

paragraphs.text: Was known, yet young as guardian of the seasons; and he quelled Araru, four-footed demon.
paragraphs.original: अयं कनीन ऋतुपा अवेद्यमिमीताररुं यश्चतुष्पात्
paragraphs.translit: ayaṃ kanīna ṛtupā avedyamimītāraruṃ yaścatuṣpāt

paragraphs.text: 11. Through lauds of him hath Ausija Rjisvan burst, with the Mighty's aid, the stall of Pipru.
paragraphs.original: अस्य स्तोमेभिरौशिज ऋजिश्वा व्रजं दरयद्वृषभेण पिप्रोः ।
paragraphs.translit: asya stomebhirauśija ṛjiśvā vrajaṃ darayadvṛṣabheṇa piproḥ |

paragraphs.text: When the saint pressed the juice and shone as singer, he seized the forts and with his craft subdued them.
paragraphs.original: सुत्वा यद्यजतो दीदयद्गीः पुर इयानो अभि वर्पसा भूत्
paragraphs.translit: sutvā yadyajato dīdayadgīḥ pura iyāno abhi varpasā bhūt

paragraphs.text: 12. So, swiftly Asura, for exaltation, hath the great Vamraka come nigh to Indra.
paragraphs.original: एवा महो असुर वक्षथाय वम्रकः पड्भिरुप सर्पदिन्द्रम् ।
paragraphs.translit: evā maho asura vakṣathāya vamrakaḥ paḍbhirupa sarpadindram |

paragraphs.text: He will, when supplicated, bring him blessing: he hath brought all, food, strength, a happy dwelling.
paragraphs.original: स इयानः करति स्वस्तिमस्मा इषमूर्जं सुक्षितिं विश्वमाभाः
paragraphs.translit: sa iyānaḥ karati svastimasmā iṣamūrjaṃ sukṣitiṃ viśvamābhāḥ
